title: Account Executive Manager
description:
The Role
 As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of Account Executives and own one of our most critical growth levers in-market: developing talent that consistently outperforms while helping Japanese sellers succeed. This role is about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire raises the bar, every coaching conversation sharpens execution, and every decision is grounded in data — all within the realities of the Japanese market.
 You'll operate at the intersection of local and global. You'll adapt our global playbooks to how deals are actually won in Japan — where trust is earned over time, decisions are made by consensus, and relationships matter as much as the commercial case. You'll bring the rigor, along with the energy.
 You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth in a market with long, relationship-driven sales cycles.
 You'll partner cross-functionally — locally and with regional/global HQ — to improve how we sell in Japan, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.
 Build a High-Performance Team
 Hire bilingual Account Executives who can run complex, multi-stakeholder deals in-market, and raise the bar with every addition to your team — competing effectively for scarce sales talent in Tokyo.
 Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards, balanced with the trust and cohesion that Japanese teams are built on.
 Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.
 Ramp and retain talent in a competitive local labour market where strong bilingual sellers have options.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Finance team
The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.
 About the role
 Affirm is looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to support and manage our international accounting operations, with a focus on statutory accounting, statutory audits, financial statement preparation, local compliance requirements, transfer pricing, and monthly close activities.
 In this role, you will help ensure Affirm’s international entities are supported by accurate books and records, timely close execution, audit-ready documentation, and compliant local reporting. You will coordinate closely with internal Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting teams, as well as external auditors, accounting firms, tax advisors, and statutory service providers.
 You will bring strong US GAAP and local statutory accounting awareness, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across jurisdictions. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable driving work through cross-functional partners and external providers.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
 At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems , running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.
 Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
 About the role
 As a Staff Security Engineer, you will shape and deliver Duolingo’s security strategy, safeguarding our learners, employees, systems, and services. You’ll identify the highest-impact security problems, lead complex initiatives from proposal through production, and build durable security capabilities across our applications and cloud infrastructure. Working across Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and IT, you’ll make practical risk decisions, establish secure-by-default patterns, and help teams ship safely at scale. This role is based in New York City. We know great candidates bring different combinations of experience. If you meet some or most of the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply!

 Set technical direction for security across Duolingo’s applications, cloud infrastructure, and engineering systems.
 Lead complex, multi-team security initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, measurement, and ongoing ownership.
 Design and build scalable security services, controls, and automation that prevent, detect, and remediate risks with minimal manual effort.

title: Legal & Privacy Operations Associate
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Legal & Privacy Operations Associate to help the Ramp legal team scale with product and operational leverage as the business grows. You will keep legal requests moving, administer core tools and records, and automate corporate, policy, and privacy program work with Legal and cross-functional partners to accelerate Ramp’s AI products and growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support legal technology and AI workflow improvements, including implementation, training, documentation, and follow-up with vendors and internal partners.

 - Build and maintain privacy program inventories and evidence with Product, Security, IT, and Marketing, including application and third-party vendor records, AI-system use cases, data flows, and records of processing, and follow-up on identified gaps.

 - Support data subject request response and automation.

title: Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) in VZ
description:
Wir sind AXS, ein globaler Ticketinganbieter für Veranstaltungsorte, Sportclubs und Events. AXS verantwortet u.a. das Ticketing für AEG Presents, dem führenden Veranstalter von Tourneen, Festivals und Konzerte weltweit. Fans der größten Künstler wie Taylor Swift, Ed Sheeran, Kylie Minogue, Katy Perry und BLACKPINK vertrauen auf AXS, um Zugang zu Konzerten oder einzigartigen Erlebnissen wie dem Coachella Festival oder dem Hyde Park Festival zu erhalten. AXS ist eine Gesellschaft des weltweit agierenden und unabhängigen Entertainment Konzerns Anschutz Entertainment Group, Inc. (AEG), die zugleich Betreiber zahlreicher Venues sind, in Deutschland zählen die Uber Arena und Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin sowie der Barclays Arena in Hamburg dazu.
 Als Senior Marketing Manager für Deutschland verantwortest du den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung sowie den europäischen und globalen Marketingteams entwickelst und steuerst du wirkungsvolle Marketingstrategien, die den Ticketverkauf steigern, die Markenbekanntheit stärken und das Wachstum von AXS in Deutschland vorantreiben.
 Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzungsstärke, bringst ein ausgeprägtes digitales und kommerzielles Verständnis mit und entwickelst starke Partnerschaften mit unseren Venues und Veranstaltungspartnern. Dabei übersetzt du die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes in konkrete Maßnahmen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung einer internationalen Marke im Live-Entertainment.
 Aufgaben Marketingstrategie, Aufbau & Teamführung Du entwickelst und steuerst die Marketingstrategie für AXS Germany und setzt diese in messbare Maßnahmen und Kampagnen um.
 Du baust effiziente Marketingprozesse, Strukturen und Reporting-Routinen auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.
 Du definierst klare Ziele und Prioritäten und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Marketingaktivitäten.
